title: Longest-reigning monarchs
subtitle: Days on the throne
hook: Can you guess who reigned longest?
fact: Louis XIV became king at just 4 years old and later outlived both his son and his grandson.

captions.instagram:
Four rulers sat on their thrones for more than 70 years! 👑 Louis XIV of France leads with 72 years and 110 days (26,407 days).

Which of these reigns surprised you most? Tell us in the comments 👇

Source: Wikipedia, Guinness World Records (sovereign states only)
